CTRE - Compile Time Regular Expressions
========================================

Source: https://github.com/hanickadot/compile-time-regular-expressions
Commit: e34c26ba149b9fd9c34aa0f678e39739641a0d1e
Date downloaded: 2025-08-27
Branch: main
Path: /single-header/

Files included:
- ctre.hpp (single-header implementation)
- ctre-unicode.hpp (Unicode support header, downloaded 2025-08-28)
- unicode-db.hpp (Unicode database header, downloaded 2025-08-28)

License: Apache License 2.0

Note: CTRE is a C++17/20 library for compile-time regular expressions. It provides
zero-overhead regex matching by compiling patterns at compile time. This results in
significantly faster runtime performance compared to std::regex.

Features:
- Compile-time pattern compilation and validation
- Zero runtime overhead for pattern compilation
- C++17 compatible
- Header-only library
- Supports most common regex features
